messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: paging integration failed for service=notify-orch in prod. Delivery status=400 -> suppressor flagged headers. Notifying #incidents.

manny: seeing same, pages not going out to pd. received a few 400s from pager-proxy around 03:12 UTC. :eyes:

sam: confirm: the incident bot thinks deliveries succeeded (200) but upstream gateway returned 4xx for PD webhooks. I can tail logs if someone wants.

elaine: oncall-sre is currently on rotation -> @oncall-sre please confirm you got a page?

oncall-sre: I did NOT get a page. I was pulled in by this thread only. IANA: missed page from 03:11-03:14.

darya: customer impact: we have two non-responsive inbound pipelines, customers 1234 & 6789 reported delayed alerts. SLA window breached for 5m.

manny: root suspicion: header signing rotation earlier today changed `X-Pager-Sign` format. The suppressor recently got a stricter regex and may be dropping pages with unexpected headers.

sam: quick mitigation: flipping suppressor to permissive passthrough for `notify-orch` in prod. Doing safe toggle now: `./scripts/suppressor_toggle --service notify-orch --mode permissive`

ops-bot: runbook entry: TRIGGER_MANUAL_PAGER_OVERRIDE executed by sam at 03:17 UTC.

elaine: manual mitigation in place. Can we confirm PD received the queued pages? sam, did the webhook retry queue drain?

sam: checking backlog: `redis-cli -n 2 LRANGE pd:retry:notify-orch 0 50` shows ~8 items. I'm pushing them via `pd-replay` now. Output: ```
pdreplay --queue notify-orch --limit 50
[INFO] replayed 8 webhooks -> PD 202 Accepted
```

oncall-sre: I just got two SMS pages and a manual call from ops. Thanks for the manual reroute. Please document fallback steps in the incident.

darya: noted customer escalation emails sent. Status page updated to "degraded paging".

manny: root cause follow-up: suppressor config regeneration job ran at 02:59 and applied a new header-block regex. devops PR: https://git.internal/r/ops/suppressor/changes/4392 (reverting for hotfix).

elaine: action items: 1) revert suppressor regex (manny) 2) ensure replay drained (sam) 3) postmortem draft (darya) 4) adjust runbook to auto-fallback to SMS for PD failures (oncall-sre).

sam: replay finished and PD acked all. Removing permissive passthrough after backlog cleared. `./scripts/suppressor_toggle --service notify-orch --mode normal`

ops-bot: NOTE: Incident assigned -> INC-2026-309. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-309

oncall-sre: will add SMS fallback to runbook and a smoke test that triggers a webhook and expects PD ACK within 15s.

darya: marking customer impact window 03:11-03:19 UTC (~8m). Will include exact affected customers in followup.

manny: hotfix merged to revert regex, deploying now. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/suppressor -n prod`

elaine: monitoring: PD deliveries returning 2xx again. Watching for recurrence.

oncall-sre: thanks everyone. After action: pair w/ devops to add canary to suppressor config regen job.

darya: assigning postmortem lead to @manny. I'll collate logs and incoming customer reports.

ops-bot: Incident closed (manual) by elaine at 03:30 UTC. Postmortem checklist created.
